prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent idle boss sprite for a Maple-inspired side-view 2D RPG lab.
Primary request: Create one full-body pixel-art Jadeplume Terrorshroom based closely on the supplied references.
Input images: Image 1 is full-body model appearance and anatomy; image 2 shows actual in-game side silhouettes, use the normal anatomy, not burning or activated effects.
Subject: one birdlike fungal creature, facing left in a grounded relaxed idle pose, both thick stalk legs planted at the same ground line. Preserve the tall swept dark teal leafy head crest, small pointed beak, layered ivory neck/chest feathers, two orange curled trailing tendrils, deep green folded wings, broad pale green fan tail with darker green tips, ochre diamond spikes and warm yellow-orange inner fan panels. Legs are pale woody stalks with mossy green broad feet, not ordinary thin bird toes.
Style/medium: crisp deliberately simplified pixel art with chunky clusters, dark colored outline and limited shades, suitable for rendering at 160 pixels tall then 120 and 80 pixels. Favor recognizable silhouette and large color regions over noisy texture. No smooth painted gradients or tiny speckles.
Composition/framing: whole creature, all tail tips and feet visible, comfortable transparent margin. Three-quarter side view facing left, close to image 1 but static with both feet planted. Tail spreads behind to right, proportions close to reference. One sprite only, no ground, shadow, UI, text, particles, attack effects or ornamental pedestal.
Constraints: real alpha transparency outside creature, preserve reference identity, idle only. Fine leaf veins and decorative scales may be simplified. No animation sheet or multiple copies.
